_readme: What is currently being measured. One entry per live experiment. Only the GA4 event pair lives here, because prose in docs/project-log/decisions.md cannot name a denominator; the narrative of the change is picked up automatically from the project log by parse_timeline(). DELETE an entry when the experiment concludes. min_sample is a MINIMUM REVIEW THRESHOLD, not a proof threshold: below it the dashboard refuses to let anyone read the result at all, and reaching it only means the result is worth looking at. It never declares a winner, and the purchase count is always shown beside the engagement count so a healthy-looking rate on zero sales cannot be mistaken for success.

experiments.name: CW bridge offer revision
experiments.notes: Offer impression fires at 50% card visibility. Do not change the bridge card, its copy, or the price while this reads KEEP MEASURING. When it reads REVIEW ELIGIBLE, that is a prompt for Brew to look, not a result: judge it on purchases, not on CTA clicks.
